A factory manufactures cars with 5 doors. The factory was planning to produce 200 cars but due to metal shortages, they decreased the production by 50 cars. Due to a pandemic, they also had to cut production by another 50%. How many doors will the factory produce?

Initially, the factory planned to produce 200 cars. Due to metal shortages, they decreased production by 50 cars, resulting in a new production plan of 150 cars (200 - 50 = 150). Then, due to the pandemic, they had to cut production by another 50%, which means they will produce only 50% of the 150 cars. 

To find the final number of cars produced, we calculate 50% of 150:
\[ 150 \times 0.5 = 75 \]

Each car has 5 doors, so the total number of doors produced is:
\[ 75 \times 5 = 375 \]

Thus, the factory will produce 375 doors.

FINAL: 375
